metadata.title: Micron's stock looks set for a bounce on Wednesday - MarketWatch

content.text:
2 hours ago
Micron's stock looks set for a bounce on Wednesday
Following a bruising Tuesday selloff, Micron's stock looks poised to trade higher in Wednesday action.
The stock is up 3% in premarket trades, while other semiconductor shares seem set to bounce as well. Arm Holdings shares are up 3% in premarket action, while Sandisk shares are ahead more than 2% and Marvell shares are up more than 1%.
